project: ไร่สุขใจ (Rai Sukjai): a Thai-countryside farming game
about: Central asset list. The mechanics agent (Claude Code) writes each asset's spec and prompt. The asset agent reads it, creates the file at `output` and stamps the status fields back here. Full rules: assets/README.md.

statuses.in_progress: claimed by an asset agent (set `agent` and `updated_at`)
statuses.done: file created at `output`; `file` set to that path; waiting for review
statuses.needs_changes: reviewer wrote what to fix in `review`; asset agent redoes it and sets done again
statuses.approved: accepted; the game may use it
statuses.blocked: cannot be done as specified; explain in `notes`

protocol.everything_else: owned by the mechanics agent; do not change it. Leave suggestions in `notes`.

style_guide.look: Warm, hand-drawn cartoon in the style of 2000s Flash games: thick dark-brown outlines (#3a2213) about 2–3 px at 1× with round joins and caps, flat colour fills, at most one simple highlight or shade shape per part, slightly chunky and friendly proportions. No gradients (except the sky in backgrounds), no photorealism, no soft airbrush shading, no drop shadows (the game adds shadows).
style_guide.setting: Central Thai countryside (rice paddies, sugar palms, wooden stilt houses, village market). Culturally accurate and respectful details.
style_guide.originality: Original art only. Do NOT copy or trace the original 'The Farmer' / 'Sim Farm' Flash game graphics or any other existing game.
style_guide.text: No text inside images unless the prompt asks for it. The game renders all labels itself.
file_rules: SVG preferred: viewBox="0 0 W H" matching `canvas`, and width/height attributes equal to the canvas.
Transparent background for everything except `background` assets.
Self-contained: no external links, fonts, scripts or embedded raster images. Convert text to paths.
Prefix any id attributes with the asset id with dots replaced by '-' (e.g. crop-phrik-s3-leaf) so files can be inlined together.
Keep each file under 40 KB; backgrounds under 200 KB.
If SVG is impossible, a PNG at 2× the canvas size is accepted: save it next to `output` with a .png extension and put that path in `file`.
style_guide.anchor: `anchor` is the [x, y] point in canvas pixels that the game places on the target spot. For crops it is the soil point the plant grows from. For characters, animals and props it is where the feet or base touch the ground. For icons it is the centre.
style_guide.consistency: Keep the same outline weight, palette and lighting (light from top-left) across all assets. The five stages of one crop must clearly be the same plant growing.
style_guide.isometric: The farm scene is ISOMETRIC (2:1 dimetric): grid point (gx, gy) at height z maps to screen x = 290 + (gx - gy)·32, y = 226 + (gx + gy)·16 - z. Ground-plane directions: +gx runs down-right (32, 16) per tile, +gy runs down-left (-32, 16). Vertical edges stay vertical. Market and duck pen stay in front view.

categories.crop: Plant at a growth stage, drawn over a soil tile. Canvas 64×64, anchor (32,56). Keep the plant inside x 6–58 and y 4–60 so neighbouring plots overlap only slightly.
categories.crop_overlay: Transparent layer placed on top of a crop.
categories.produce_icon: Harvested item, 32×32, centred. Reused at 18–40 px.
categories.hud_icon: Small HUD icon, 24×24, must read at 17 px.
categories.tile: Isometric soil block for one farm plot: 2:1 diamond top face (56×28) plus a 7 px deep block. Canvas 64×40, anchor (32,16) = centre of the top face. 48 of them sit in 4 fields of 4×3.
categories.tile_overlay: Transparent layer placed on top of an isometric soil tile (same canvas and anchor).
categories.character: People. Anchor = between the feet (or the waist for Auntie Daeng).
categories.animal: Animals. Anchor = ground under the body.
categories.prop: Interactive or foreground objects. Anchor = base on the ground.
categories.background: Full 800×600 stage. Respect the KEEP CLEAR zones in the prompt.

assets.name_th: ควาย
assets.prompt: The BODY of a calm grey Thai water buffalo in isometric 3/4 view, facing DOWN-LEFT (toward +gy): barrel body with its long axis running up-right to down-left, four sturdy legs with dark hooves (far legs darker), lighter belly shading, and a small white egret standing on its back. NO head and NO tail: those are separate assets (animal.buffalo_head, animal.buffalo_tail) so the game can animate them. Leave the neck end open around (58,50) and the rump around (142,46). Anchor (88,100) = ground under the body. The farm scene is ISOMETRIC (2:1 dimetric): grid point (gx, gy) at height z maps to screen x = 290 + (gx - gy)·32, y = 226 + (gx + gy)·16 - z. Ground-plane directions: +gx runs down-right (32, 16) per tile, +gy runs down-left (-32, 16). Vertical edges stay vertical. Market and duck pen stay in front view.
assets.notes: 3/4 view facing down-left: body, four legs (far legs darker), belly shade, egret on the back. Head and tail are separate parts.

assets.name_th: หัวควาย
assets.prompt: Head of the same buffalo, 3/4 view facing down-left: broad grey skull, big thick crescent horns (cream) swept out and back, ears, both eyes visible, a wide pale-grey muzzle with nostrils. Anchor (66,50) is the NECK PIVOT: the game places it at the body's neck and rotates the head around it to graze, so keep the neck end at the anchor and nothing of the body in this file.
assets.notes: Broad skull, thick swept-back horns, ears, both eyes, wide pale muzzle. Pivot at the neck (66,50).

assets.name_th: หางควาย
assets.prompt: Tail of the same buffalo: a thin grey tail hanging from the rump with a dark tuft at the end. Anchor (8,6) is the ATTACHMENT PIVOT: the game swings the tail around it.
assets.notes: Hanging tail with dark tuft. Pivot at the rump (8,6).

assets.name_th: ฉากไร่
assets.prompt:
Full-stage ISOMETRIC background for the central Thai village farm. The farm scene is ISOMETRIC (2:1 dimetric): grid point (gx, gy) at height z maps to screen x = 290 + (gx - gy)·32, y = 226 + (gx + gy)·16 - z. Ground-plane directions: +gx runs down-right (32, 16) per tile, +gy runs down-left (-32, 16). Vertical edges stay vertical.

Top (y 0–160): sky gradient, yellow sun top-left, birds, far pale hills, a small distant temple and chedi around x 200, and a tree line on the horizon at y 160. Behind the yard's upper-left edge: rice paddies laid out on the iso grid (cells 1.6×2 tiles, raised dikes along both grid axes, some water-filled cells, rice tufts, egrets), sugar palms, a small field hut and a scarecrow; an irrigation canal with a plank bridge runs along the yard side of the paddies. Behind the yard's upper-right edge: grass, a coconut tree, the spirit house (ศาลพระภูมิ) around grid (0.7,-2.1), and the wooden stilt house (บ้านใต้ถุนสูง) in 3/4 view on grid gx 2.3–6.3, gy -4.7–-2.3: posts, floor at z≈64, plank walls to z≈116 with opened shutters, door on the gable end, steep red gable roof with ridge along gx at z≈160 and crossed kalae boards, a hammock, bench and water jar underneath, and a ladder stair down toward the yard. Buffalo paddock on grid gx 8–12.6, gy -5–-2: muddy grass, a hay pile and ONLY its two back fences (along gy=-5 and gx=8).

MUST MATCH THE GAME EXACTLY: the raised dirt yard block over grid gx -0.8–9.8, gy -0.8–7.8 (top #d6b277, sides #b08a50/#c29a5e, 12 px deep) and the four grass field bunds over gx -0.25–4.25 / 4.75–9.25 by gy -0.25–3.25 / 3.75–7.25 (top #8fb04a, sides #6f8f3a/#7ea042, 6 px deep). The game draws the 48 soil plots and crops on top.

KEEP CLEAR (plain ground only): front-left of the yard x 0–260, y 380–532 (ox cart and its sign); x 540–700, y 380–532 (dragon jar and farmer); x 700–800, y 395–532 (signposts); inside the paddock (buffalo). Do not draw clouds, the buffalo, the paddock's front fence, the plots or any props. The HUD covers y 0–46 and the toolbar y 532–600.
assets.notes: Isometric background (159 KB). Rice fields: paddy cells on the grid with raised earthen dikes along both axes, rows of rice clumps, water paddies with reflections, young/green/golden paddies, a canal with a plank bridge, a scarecrow, egrets. Trees: sugar palms with fan fronds, fruit and shadows; pinnate coconut palms with ringed curved trunks; two banana clumps with fruit and a banana flower. Phra Phum shrine in 3/4 view: plinth, pillar, garlanded gold tray, red house with gold door, two roof tiers with chofa and a spire, soda bottles, incense and zebra figurines. Plus the stilt house, paddock (back fences, hay) and the yard/bunds matching isoFarmGround().
